project: Unified Market Data Downloader & Quant Engine — Modular Edition
description: 1:1 modular refactor of upstox_app.py. No feature removed; speed + structure only.
index_policy: modular.json is written by the orchestrator (single writer => no corruption). Each agent ALSO appends a per-file line to .workflow/<agent>.jsonl and returns a structured report which the orchestrator merges here after each wave.

[critical] ML Finder crashed KeyError('Return [%]') -> use per-trade 'ReturnPct' (patterns.py)
[critical] short trailing stop never ratcheted (signed _prev_position_size) -> guard >=0 (codegen)
[high] 'Tighten Trailing Stop' zone dead code -> self._zone_tight_sl consistent (codegen)
[high] charges panel double-counted engine commission + mislabeled gross -> add-back true gross (backtester)
[high] slowness REAL cause: render_instrument_selector rescanned 141k rows/keystroke -> precomputed per-class meta (components/app_main); keystroke 90ms->33ms
[high] Optuna fed floats into int params (masked -999) -> suggest_int for integer lists + raise on all-fail (optimizer)

[med] yearly drawdown used min() reported ~0% -> max() (metrics); WAL once not per-connect (db); resample vectorized 40x (resample); engine quality gate; ML labeled exploratory; volume guard; content dataset_hash
